headline: Dollar rises in price: currency rates in Kazakhstan for November 17
summary: The official US dollar rate stood at 444.40 tenge on November 17. Exchange offices in the megacities offered the dollar in a range of 441 to 448 tenge.
why: The tenge's exchange rate against the dollar affects import costs, inflation and the valuation of dollar-denominated debt in Kazakhstan.
